content.raw:
Hammond Realty values your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, and property preferences when you:

  • Fill out a contact form on our website
  • Request a home valuation
  • Subscribe to receive updates or messages from us

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to:

  • Communicate with you about real estate services
  • Send you updates, follow-ups, and other relevant messages
  • Improve our services and personalize your experience

SMS Consent

By submitting your phone number, you consent to receive SMS messages from Hammond Realty. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency may vary. You can reply STOP at any time to opt out, or HELP for more information.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

Data Protection

Your data is securely stored and only accessed by authorized personnel. We will never sell, rent, or share your information with outside parties.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

Hammond Realty
(916) 625-6118
blakehammondre@gmail.com

acf.hero_heading:
Buy With Confidence.
Sell For Top Dollar.
acf.hero_body: Full-service listings, expert negotiation for buyers, and fully funded pre-market home preparation with no upfront costs.

featured_testimonials.quote: Blake did a wonderful job for us and got our house sold on the very first day it was listed. We could not be any happier with his help. We highly recommend him because we know he will take really good care of you.
featured_testimonials.name: Tim Tingey

featured_testimonials.quote: Excellent experience. Blake was supportive, provided clear recommendations, and worked around our schedules as busy professionals. The house sold extremely quickly and the staging was wonderfully done.
featured_testimonials.name: Christine Smith

featured_testimonials.quote: An outstanding job. Blake went above and beyond for those unfamiliar with the real estate world. He brought together all the services needed for the sale and made this transaction possible in a short time.
featured_testimonials.name: Larry Ciche

acf.help_body: Skip high-pressure pitches. Expect honest advice, active market tracking, and answers that protect your money.

help_cards.title: Buying
help_cards.desc: We skip the sales pitches to focus entirely on protecting your contract and getting your offer accepted.

help_cards.title: Selling
help_cards.desc: Maximize profit with accurate pricing and high-impact marketing, with the option to leverage our Home Prep Selling Program.

help_cards.title: Home Prep Program
help_cards.desc: We fund and manage 100% of your home preparation and repairs to drive up your sale price, paying nothing until it's sold.

acf.process_subtitle: A practical roadmap to outpace local market averages.

process_buying_steps.title: Book A Free Strategy Call
process_buying_steps.desc: Skip the sales pitch. We jump on a quick call to map your budget, target neighborhoods, and secure a hassle-free pre-approval.

process_buying_steps.title: Finding the Right House
process_buying_steps.desc: We look past the polished photos on the apps, narrow down the neighborhoods that actually make sense for you, and track down the best properties on the market.

process_buying_steps.title: Safe Offer & Smooth Close
process_buying_steps.desc: We use raw sales data to build a competitive offer with ironclad safeguards, vet structural inspections, and close with confidence.

process_selling_steps.title: Free Consultation
process_selling_steps.desc: Map your goals, timeline, and neighborhood pricing strategy based on local market trends.

process_selling_steps.title: Prepare Your Home for Sale
process_selling_steps.desc: We handle staging and premium video marketing. You can also take advantage of our Home Prep Program for home improvements and repairs we manage with no out-of-pocket costs or hidden fees.

process_selling_steps.title: Place Your Home on the Market
process_selling_steps.desc: Attract serious buyers fast with high-impact online listings, coordinated showings, and proactive marketing.

process_selling_steps.title: Accept Offer & Close
process_selling_steps.desc: Navigate offers on your home with expert negotiation, manage complex escrow paperwork, and experience a stress-free closing.

process_preparing_steps.title: Consultation & Audit
process_preparing_steps.desc: Walk through your property together to pinpoint the specific upgrades and repairs that buyers pay a premium for.

process_preparing_steps.title: Upfront Renovation Funding
process_preparing_steps.desc: The Home Prep Program funds 100% of the upfront costs for home improvements and repairs, so you pay nothing out of pocket.

process_preparing_steps.title: Project Management
process_preparing_steps.desc: Trusted local tradespeople are hired and managed to handle absolutely anything your home needs, from paint and flooring to kitchen updates, landscaping, and junk removal.

process_preparing_steps.title: Staging & Media
process_preparing_steps.desc: Transform the refreshed space with premium design styling and high-production photography to drive immediate buyer urgency.

process_preparing_steps.title: High-Profit Close
process_preparing_steps.desc: Secure top-dollar offers, manage final transaction details, and settle the update costs out of proceeds only when escrow closes.

acf.why_heading: Why Homeowners Choose Blake Over the Competition

why_bullets.title: Home Prep Program
why_bullets.desc: We handle and fund 100% of your home preparation, repairs, and improvements so you sell for more and pay nothing until closing.

why_bullets.title: Record of Success
why_bullets.desc: Sold 18 homes that were previously listed by other agents and failed to sell.

why_bullets.title: No Comforting Lies
why_bullets.desc: You get the unfiltered truth and raw market data. I'd rather protect your equity with hard facts than comfort you with a lie.

title.raw: Home Prep Program
title.rendered: Home Prep Program

acf.hero_heading: We Prepare Your Home For Sale. You Pay Nothing Until It's Sold.
acf.hero_body: I front the cost of all repairs, updates, and staging to get your home market-ready. You pay nothing out of pocket—everything is settled from your sale proceeds at closing.
acf.familiar_body: Getting a home market-ready can easily feel expensive and overwhelming.

familiar_worries.text: "Who should I hire to do it?"

acf.why_body: Buyers reward homes that show better than the competition. This turnkey renovation program quietly removes every friction point without you writing a check before closing.

why_bullets.title: No Out-of-Pocket Costs
why_bullets.desc: We can cover the cost of repairs, updates, cleaning, and staging. You pay us back when your home sells.

why_bullets.title: No Contractor Headache
why_bullets.desc: No finding contractors or managing the work yourself. We coordinate everything from repairs and painting to cleaning and staging.

why_bullets.title: Net More Money
why_bullets.desc: The right improvements can make a big difference. We focus on the work that will help your home show its best — and skip what isn't worth doing.

why_bullets.title: Premium Marketing Launch
why_bullets.desc: Once your home is ready, we launch it with professional staging, photography, and marketing designed to make it stand out.

acf.process_heading: How the Home Prep Program Works
acf.process_subtitle: 5 steps to a stress-free, high-profit sale.

steps.title: Fix It Or Skip It Consultation

acf.hero_heading:
Beat the Competition
to the Property
acf.hero_body: Write sharp offers and out-negotiate the competition so you get the house you want without overpaying.
acf.why_body: Skip the average door-opener. You get an honest advisor who handles everything from the initial search to the final contract, ensuring you never make a blind investment.

why_bullets.title: No Property Fluff
why_bullets.desc: I point out hidden red flags, bad layouts, and neighborhood downsides so you know exactly what you're walking into.

why_bullets.title: Unfiltered Market Data
why_bullets.desc: I show you the actual sales numbers instead of just the list price so you always know the true value before you make an offer.

why_bullets.title: Strategic Negotiation
why_bullets.desc: I craft sharp, competitive bids designed to get your offer accepted on your terms while keeping your money protected.

acf.tips_heading:
Taking the Stress
Out of Buying
acf.tips_subtitle: Setting a few clear ground rules early protects your cash and saves you months of wasted weekend tours.

tips.title: Start with a Strategy Call
tips.desc: We map out a game plan tailored to your specific goals before you start tracking public sites.

tips.title: The 5-Year Reality Check
tips.desc: Buy for your current lifestyle, but ensure the property can adapt so you aren't forced to move again too soon.

tips.title: Ignore the Ugly Wallpaper
tips.desc: Separate major structural issues from minor surface updates. Outdated kitchens are easy to fix but a flawed layout is permanent.

tips.title: Lock In Your Pre-Approval
tips.desc: Sellers will not take you seriously without a verified commitment showing you are qualified to close from day one.

tips.title: Write a Tight, Clean Offer
tips.desc: Price matters, but fast timelines and protective, zero-fluff contract conditions are what actually win bidding wars.

tips.title: Budget 3% for Closing Costs
tips.desc: Expect an extra 2% to 3% beyond your down payment to safely cover your title, escrow, and lender fees.

acf.process_subtitle: Three distinct steps designed to protect your money and eliminate the guesswork.

steps.title: Book A Free Strategy Call
steps.desc: Skip the sales pitch. We jump on a quick call to map your budget, target neighborhoods, and secure a hassle-free pre-approval.

steps.title: Finding the Right House
steps.desc: We look past the polished photos on the apps, narrow down the neighborhoods that actually make sense for you, and track down the best properties on the market.

steps.title: Safe Offer & Smooth Close
steps.desc: We use raw sales data to build a competitive offer with ironclad safeguards, vet structural inspections, and close with confidence.

acf.hero_heading: I Tell You The Truth, Especially When It’s Hard.
acf.hero_body: A calm, protective partner who handles the contractors, guides you through complex moves, and uses a 100% funded Home Prep Program to get you the most money for your home.
acf.bio_heading: Built to Guide Families Through Complex Moves

bio_paragraphs.text: Real estate is about more than property, it is about guiding families safely through major life changes. Growing up with two brothers on the autism spectrum instilled an early understanding of patience, deep empathy, and how to steady families through difficult transitions.

Since 2020, this background has fueled a specialization in helping homeowners win in complex situations. Whether managing estate sales, divorce, job relocations, or taking over listings that failed to sell with previous agents, the focus remains on resolving challenges where traditional approaches get stuck. Advanced training under top national sales coaches translates this proven strategy into top-dollar results.
Outside of defending client equity, life centers around family in a local home shared with a high school sweetheart and wife, son Daniel, and a cat, Jingles.

Integrity-Driven Service
from Start to Finish

values.title: Honesty Over Comfort
values.desc: Expect unfiltered facts on pricing and market timing, never false promises, ensuring smart, profitable decisions.

values.title: Total Transparency
values.desc: No being kept in the dark. Clients are fully looped in at every single stage of the transaction to always know what comes next.

values.title: Complex Problem Solving
values.desc: Specializing in properties that should have sold but did not, using refined marketing systems to secure top dollar with less stress.

acf.help_body: Skip high-pressure pitches. Expect honest advice, active market tracking, and answers that protect your money.

title.raw: How does your advanced training help me?
title.rendered: How does your advanced training help me?

acf.question: How does your advanced training help me?
acf.answer: Coached by top real estate consultants, field-tested negotiation and pricing techniques are deployed to consistently beat average neighborhood days on market.

title.raw: Will I work directly with Blake?
title.rendered: Will I work directly with Blake?

acf.question: Will I work directly with Blake?
acf.answer: Yes. Direct access to Blake is standard from start to finish with no call centers, hand-offs, or junior representatives.

title.raw: Why emphasize direct honesty?
title.rendered: Why emphasize direct honesty?

acf.question: Why emphasize direct honesty?
acf.answer: Real numbers are essential for smart financial decisions. Equity is protected with facts rather than temporary comfort or market lies.

title.raw: What situations do you specialize in?
title.rendered: What situations do you specialize in?

acf.question: What situations do you specialize in?
acf.answer: Traditional moves are fully supported, but expertise excels in complex sales, including estates, divorce, relocations, and listings that failed to sell previously.

title.raw: Will I be involved in budget decisions?
title.rendered: Will I be involved in budget decisions?

acf.question: Will I be involved in budget decisions?
acf.answer: Absolutely. Before any work begins, you will sign off on the exact project bid, scope of work, and clear budget.

title.raw: Do I have to use your contractors?
title.rendered: Do I have to use your contractors?

acf.question: Do I have to use your contractors?
acf.answer: Yes. To guarantee quality and stay on schedule, we use our own vetted network of local tradespeople and cannot bring in outside vendors.

title.raw: How long does the renovation take?
title.rendered: How long does the renovation take?

acf.question: How long does the renovation take?
acf.answer: Typically 1 to 2 weeks, depending on the scope. We will provide an exact, clear timeline during our initial walkthrough.

title.raw: What if my home doesn't sell?
title.rendered: What if my home doesn’t sell?

acf.question: What if my home doesn't sell?
acf.answer: If you take your home off the market before it sells, you simply pay back the actual renovation costs spent. We review everything together upfront so there are zero surprises.

title.raw: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?
title.rendered: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?

acf.question: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?
acf.answer: Absolutely nothing. All vendor and material costs are settled at closing out of your sale proceeds, so you never pay out of pocket.

title.raw: Will I be involved in design and approval decisions?
title.rendered: Will I be involved in design and approval decisions?

acf.question: Will I be involved in design and approval decisions?
acf.answer: Always. You maintain final approval over the project scope, finishes, and budget before work starts, backed by clear weekly progress updates.

title.raw: Do I have to use your renovation contractors?
title.rendered: Do I have to use your renovation contractors?

acf.question: Do I have to use your renovation contractors?
acf.answer: A vetted network is what keeps the program running quickly and smoothly, but any specific parts you prefer to handle yourself can easily be accommodated.

title.raw: How long does the renovation process usually take?
title.rendered: How long does the renovation process usually take?

acf.question: How long does the renovation process usually take?
acf.answer: Most homes are market-ready within 2 to 4 weeks depending on the scope of the updates. A clear timeline is provided during the initial walkthrough.

title.raw: What if my home doesn't end up selling?
title.rendered: What if my home doesn’t end up selling?

acf.question: What if my home doesn't end up selling?
acf.answer: Complete transparency is maintained regarding the rare scenarios where costs would be owed, and the straightforward agreement is reviewed together before any work begins.

title.raw: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?
title.rendered: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?

acf.question: How much does the Home Prep Selling Program cost upfront?
acf.answer: Absolutely nothing. All vendor and material costs are settled at closing out of your sale proceeds, so you never pay out of pocket.

title.raw: Will you handle showings and feedback?
title.rendered: Will you handle showings and feedback?

acf.question: Will you handle showings and feedback?
acf.answer: Yes. Every showing is fully coordinated, hosted, and tracked, with direct buyer feedback shared during your regular weekly update.

title.raw: What does it cost to list with you?
title.rendered: What does it cost to list with you?

acf.question: What does it cost to list with you?
acf.answer: All marketing, representation, and commission structures are reviewed transparently during our first call with zero surprises or restrictive terms.

title.raw: How long does it take to sell?
title.rendered: How long does it take to sell?

acf.question: How long does it take to sell?
acf.answer: Accurately priced, well-prepared homes typically secure competitive interest within the first few weeks. Timelines are intentionally aligned around your moving goals.

title.raw: What does your prep program include?
title.rendered: What does your prep program include?

acf.question: What does your prep program include?
acf.answer: It covers the initial property consultation, direct contractor coordination, professional staging, and high-end photography and video production.

title.raw: How do you decide on a list price?
title.rendered: How do you decide on a list price?

acf.question: How do you decide on a list price?
acf.answer: Recent neighborhood sales are analyzed, your home's unique features are evaluated, and current buyer demand is measured to set a strategic asking price.

title.raw: What does it cost to work with you as a buyer?
title.rendered: What does it cost to work with you as a buyer?

acf.question: What does it cost to work with you as a buyer?
acf.answer: All representation and industry commission structures are explained transparently during our very first conversation with zero surprises.

title.raw: Do you help with off-market or coming-soon listings?
title.rendered: Do you help with off-market or coming-soon listings?

acf.question: Do you help with off-market or coming-soon listings?
acf.answer: Yes. An active professional network uncovers properties before they hit public search apps, giving you an early advantage.

title.raw: How long does it take to find and close on a home?
title.rendered: How long does it take to find and close on a home?

title.rendered: How does the Home Prep Selling Program work?

acf.answer: The program fronts the entire cost of updates, staging, and cosmetic repairs that drive a premium sale price. Homeowners pay nothing upfront, and the renovation investment is settled comfortably at closing out of your sale proceeds.
